idea-plugin.name: Branch Monitor for Jenkins
idea-plugin.description:
See the Jenkins builds of your branches right in the IDE — no more hunting through Jenkins per repository and branch.

  • Zero config discovery: detects all Git roots and their checked-out branches and finds the matching Jenkins multibranch jobs automatically (folders, encoded branch names, manual mapping as fallback). Optionally also watches repositories whose VCS mapping is disabled or that are not registered in the IDE. Single repositories can be excluded per project; a diagnostics view shows how the job URL is derived.
  • Compact table view: status bubble (blue = building, green = success, red = failed, yellow = unstable, gray = unknown), repository, branch, build number, result/time and your push state. Columns can be hidden and sorted.
  • Follows your pushes: pushed branches stay monitored after you switch branches. You are notified when your build passes or turns green again — and a dialog pops up when it breaks — builds triggered by others never spam you.
  • Build logs inside the IDE: right-click a build to open its console log in a tool window tab with live tail, error highlighting and "jump to next error" — or open the build in the browser.
  • Pull guard: asks before you pull or update a branch whose Jenkins build is currently red — pull anyway or cancel.
  • Status bar widget: worst build state at a glance plus your push statistics per workspace (pushes, green and red builds — own builds only).
  • Adaptive polling, API token stored in the IDE password safe.

Strictly read-only: the plugin only reads build status and logs via HTTP GET. It never triggers, aborts, replays or modifies builds.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.2

  • The first red build after your push now opens a dialog (Show Log / Open in Browser / Close) instead of an easily missed balloon. Further failing rebuilds of the same push stay quiet.

0.3.1

  • Renamed to Branch Monitor for Jenkins.
  • Prepared for the JetBrains Marketplace (license, vendor, plugin verification).

0.3.0

  • New settings page Branch Monitor for Jenkins › Repositories (per project): overview of all Git repositories found, with a checkbox to stop monitoring single repositories. Excluded repositories are also skipped by the pull guard and the push statistics.
  • Diagnostics: shows the Git information (root, source, remote URL, branch) the job URL is derived from, and Check Job Resolution lists every job URL that is tried — handy when no job is found.

0.2.9

  • Job discovery: if the folder is not derivable from the remote URL (e.g. repo team/app in folder TEAM-APPS), jobs named like the repository are looked up in the Jenkins folder tree (one read-only request, cached for 10 minutes; reset with Refresh).

0.2.8

  • Log viewer: just start typing to search the log (opens the regular IDE find bar with live highlighting); also via the new Find in Log toolbar button.

0.2.7

  • Unmanaged Git roots now come entirely from the IDE's VCS root detection; branch and remote are read with the IDE's Git executable instead of parsing .git files. Branch switches are noticed via VFS events.
  • Unregistered roots: nested repositories (e.g. inside target/), excluded/ignored folders and roots outside the project content are skipped; duplicate clones of the same repo/branch are shown once.
  • Repository names from local/UNC remote paths are resolved correctly.
  • Plugin and tool window icon back to the Git branch logo.

0.2.6

  • Pull guard now also intercepts the Update Selected button of the Git tool window branches tree (that toolbar creates its own action instance and bypassed the guard).
  • Pull guard decisions are logged to idea.log for troubleshooting.

0.2.5

  • Pull guard now also covers Update Selected in the Git tool window branches tree, Update in the branch popup and Pull into current using Rebase/Merge.
  • Branches without a cached status (e.g. a non-current branch) are checked on demand (read-only, cancelable).
  • Unregistered Git roots are now found via the IDE's own VCS root detection.

0.2.4

  • Type in the build table to filter jobs (IntelliJ speed search).
  • Log/browser menu opens on right-click (or Shift+F10) only.
  • New binoculars icons.

0.2.3

  • New plugin icon and tool window icon.

0.2.2

  • Build logs are shown in a regular IDE console, so console plugins such as Grep Console apply to them as well.

0.2.1

  • Fix: build logs stayed empty.
  • Fix: log tabs can be closed again.
  • Table columns are as wide as their content.

0.2.0

  • New table view with separate columns (status, repository, branch, build, result, your push); hide columns via right-click on the header, temporary sorting by clicking a header.
  • Click a build: show the log inside the IDE (live tail, error highlighting, errors-only filter, full log in editor) or open build/job in the browser.
  • Pull guard: confirmation dialog before Git Pull / Update Project when the branch's build is red.
  • Status bar widget with worst state and your push statistics (moved out of the tool window).
  • Optional: also watch Git repositories with VCS mapping <None> or not registered in the IDE.
  • "Show Log" action in build notifications.

0.1.0

  • Initial version: automatic job discovery, push tracking, notifications for own pushes only.
